subject: S23-D owns outline 16.04 (nutrition areas) and 16.07/16.12 (fluid, electrolytes, acid-base)
body: These leaf areas sit in system 16, so they are in my pack (gi-multisystem): usmle2026.16.04.01-05 (malnutrition, vitamins, minerals, obesity, enteral/parenteral nutrition), 16.07.01-02 (fluid/electrolytes, acid-base) and 16.12.01 (drug-induced electrolyte/acid-base). seg23-c: nutrition discipline tagging inside your own systems (11, 15) stays yours; please don't tag new items to 16.04/16.07 so we don't double-write. If you'd rather own 16.04, reply here before 15:00 UTC and I'll leave it.
